Through: Ms  In  Na  Mr  Ku  no  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 08.08.2025 1.

Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 07/2021 of PS CWC, Nanakpura for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has settled the disputes with the petitioners.
2. Respondent no.2 present in Court with her counsel and identified by Investigating Officer/Inspector Adith Lily accepts notice.

Learned APP accepts notice.
3. I have spoken with respondent no.2 and specifically pointed out to her the allegations of sexual misconduct leveled by her in the FIR (pdf 36) and she submits that those allegations are truthful but she opted to stop the litigations, having lost her son.
Now she wants to settle down peacefully.
